I saved this to the project's shared memory: Priya owns the ledger integration, and any change to `src/billing/invoices.py` needs her review. It's attached to that file, so it will come up whenever someone works on it. If the integration gets a new owner, it will need updating.

There's also an existing warning about the same file. `finalize()` isn't idempotent, so calling it twice posts to the ledger twice. Use `finalize_once()` instead, and never wrap `finalize()` in retries.
